Your email address (the one used to place the order)
Your order number, if you have it handy

Photos, if you’re able to take them:
One of the shipping box (including any damage to the box)
One close-up of the damaged area on the item/plant
If you aren’t able to provide photos, just let me know and we’ll work with what you can share.
Once you send those details, the team will review everything and be in touch with next steps.
